title: Next Chapter — a trilogy about its own making

books.description: The player's origin: a vanilla-JS audiobook player forged against a 4.7-gigabyte book — and, quietly, a gift for one listener.
The generator's origin: the pipeline that researches a repository, writes its documentary, and renders it in a cloned voice — including this one.
The assembly: how this site was decided, scrubbed, and built in public — narrated through a pinned commit it cannot see past.
